IA No.1642 of 2021 (Substitution Application)
In
CLR No.32 of 2020
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate, 
for the revisionist. 
Mr. Yogesh Pant, Advocate, for the 
respondent. 
The substitution application has 
been preferred by the revisionist to 
bring on record the legal heirs of the 
revisionist (deceased) who is reported to 
have died on 29.11.2020.
Since the substitution application 
itself has been filed within time and has 
not been seriously opposed by the 
learned counsel for the respondent, the 
same would stand allowed. 
The learned counsel for the 
revisionist would carry out the 
necessary amendments in the cause title 
of the civil revision within a period of ten 
days from today. List this matter immediately after 
ten days. 
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
03.03.2021

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CLR No. 32 of 2020
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Yogesh Pant, Advocate for the 
respondent.
The learned counsel for the revisionist 
has filed a Time Extension Application (IA No. 
1643/2021), praying for an extension of time to 
comply with the order dated 09.02.2020.
After having considered the reasons, 
which have been given for non-compliance of 
the conditions, as given therein in the order 
dated 09.02.2020, which is on account of the 
ailment and subsequent death of the revisionist 
on 29.11.2020, the order could not be complied 
with.
Accordingly, the Time Extension 
Application is allowed. The learned counsel for 
the revisionist is granted further one month’s 
time to comply with the order dated 09.02.2020.
The Time Extension Application is 
disposed of accordingly.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 23.03.2021 Mahinder/

Kushal Singh Rawat
--Revisionist
 Versus
Smt. Susheela Devi
--Respondent
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. B.S. Kathayat, learned counsel for the 
revisionist.
2. Mr. V.K. Kaparuwan, learned counsel for 
the respondent. 
3. Learned counsel for the revisionist submits 
that due to some unavoidable circumstances the 
revisionist could not comply with the interim 
order passed by this Court, as a result of which, 
the respondent has initiated execution 
proceedings for execution of decree passed by 
the Trial Court. He would submit that the next 
date fixed before the Executing Court is 
17.08.2026.
4. Learned counsel for the revisionist has 
handed over a draft of ₹ 85,800/-, payable at 
Uttarakhand Co-operative Bank Limited, 
Rishikesh, to the learned counsel for the 
respondent in the Court today. A photocopy of 
the same is also placed on record.
5. In the facts and circumstance of the case, 
it is provided that if the revisionist deposits the  balance amount in compliance of the interim 
order passed by this Court before the Executing 
Court within a period of ten days from today, the 
revisionist would be entitled to move an 
application for adjournment before the Executing 
Court, which shall be considered by the said 
Court for grant of adjournment till 11.09.2026.
6. List this case for orders on 11.09.2026.
7. Urgency Application IA No.1647/2026 is 
disposed of. 
 (Subhash Upadhyay, J.) 
 14.08.2026
Rajni
